description:
## Goal

Make every production publisher calculate and validate one complete typed event payload before any semantic value becomes visible. One completion applies the accepted payload, ownership claims and changed-value movements together.

A publication event is not a whole-program pass and not a staged World. The transient payload disappears after completion; existing World stores and the existing output ledger remain the only authorities.

## Complete scope

Migrate source discovery, scope and namespace publication, modules, types, structs, protocols and providers, specs, references, requester expectations, external interfaces, callsite values, semantic values, generated lambdas and declarations, lazy runtime reservations and runtime demand. Interning an identity must not silently publish a definition or obligation.

Validate every represented domain before applying the event. Rejection publishes nothing. Complete_job is the sole apply point.

## Same-source macros

An accepted declaration prefix is one durable source-qualified publication event. Macro expansion is a separately owned dependent event that reads that prefix through ordinary facts and products. If expansion fails, the accepted prefix remains justified while the expansion attempt completes as Failed under fz-tfn.46.

The prefix completion owns each earlier callable declaration, raw FunctionSourceStash and callable kind before a dependent same-module item-macro event executes. The dependent event reads those ordinary facts and products but never borrows or owns the prefix claims. If that event blocks or fails, the accepted prefix remains published and a relevant correction reruns only the dependent event. fz-tfn.62 separately removes the redundant owning-ModuleDefined gate from EntryDispatch after proving its exact function, type, struct and guard dependencies.

Do not expose proposed same-event definitions provisionally, hold an indivisible whole-source job across macro execution, stage a second World, compare before and after World images, roll back escaped mutations or retain a shadow owner map.

## TDD

Begin with Provider defining helper/1 and make_answer/0, where make_answer returns a fresh answer/0 definition that calls Provider.helper/1, then invokes make_answer as an item macro. Inject a failure after the helper and macro prefix is accepted. Prove those prefix facts publish once and remain justified, the dependent expansion owns none of them, unchanged or unrelated movement performs no retry, and a relevant correction reruns only the dependent expansion. fz-tfn.62 owns the successful no-self-cycle and exact helper-identity control.

Inject conflict or failure at every position of mixed-domain events. Prove either complete publication or none, with World values and ledger claims always coherent. Cover generated-lambda lowering failure, late external-interface conflict, blocked runtime reservation, requester expectations, same-source prefix success followed by macro failure, and equal rediscovery of an already Defined module.

Equal reproduction preserves values, allocations and generations and wakes nobody. Preserve lazy lowering, exact diagnostics, unchanged and unrelated zero work, semantic answers and artifacts.

## Deletion and acceptance

Delete mutation-before-completion paths, module and type overwrite paths, separate reference publication, append-only obligations, store-without-ledger helpers, stale callsite values, rollback and reconciliation concepts, and docs describing partial publication. Full focused, causal, library, fixture, CLI, deterministic, documentation, formatting, check and strict-Clippy gates pass; fresh ticket-scoped cold review precedes one commit and close.
title: Publish validated source contributions as one typed batch
